title: 醫療緊急
description: 醫療緊急狀況的求助用語

sentences.en: I need an ambulance immediately because my friend, who has a heart condition, just collapsed on the floor.
sentences.zh: 我需要立刻叫救護車，因為我朋友有心臟病史，剛剛倒在地上了。

sentences.en: Could you please call emergency services for the elderly woman sitting over there, who appears to be having difficulty breathing?
sentences.zh: 能否請你幫坐在那邊的老婦人叫急救服務，她似乎呼吸困難。

sentences.en: The patient, suffering from severe chest pain radiating down his left arm, needs to be transported to the nearest hospital.
sentences.zh: 這位病人胸口劇痛並延伸到左臂，需要立刻送往最近的醫院。

sentences.en: I am allergic to penicillin, which is something the doctor should know before prescribing any medication for my infection.
sentences.zh: 我對盤尼西林過敏，這是醫生在開任何感染藥物之前應該知道的事。

sentences.en: My daughter, who is only three years old, accidentally swallowed a small battery that was inside her toy.
sentences.zh: 我女兒只有三歲，她不小心吞了玩具裡面的一顆小電池。

sentences.en: Having been stung by what appears to be a jellyfish, I am experiencing intense pain and swelling on my right leg.
sentences.zh: 我似乎被水母螫了，右腿正在劇烈疼痛和腫脹。

sentences.en: The man lying unconscious near the entrance, who was previously complaining of dizziness, has not responded for several minutes.
sentences.zh: 躺在入口附近不省人事的男子之前一直說頭暈，已經好幾分鐘沒有反應了。

sentences.en: I need to find a pharmacy that is open at this hour because I have run out of my blood pressure medication.
sentences.zh: 我需要找一家現在還營業的藥局，因為我的血壓藥已經吃完了。

sentences.en: Please help me explain to the doctor that I have been experiencing sharp abdominal pain since early this morning.
sentences.zh: 請幫我向醫生解釋，我從今天一大早開始就有劇烈的腹痛。

sentences.en: The child, who fell from the playground equipment approximately ten minutes ago, is crying and unable to move his arm.
sentences.zh: 那個大約十分鐘前從遊樂設施上摔下來的孩子一直在哭，手臂無法動彈。

sentences.en: Is there a doctor or nurse nearby who could help assess the condition of this woman, who seems to be going into shock?
sentences.zh: 附近有沒有醫生或護士可以幫忙評估這位女士的狀況？她似乎快要休克了。

sentences.en: I forgot to bring my insulin, which I need to inject before every meal, and the nearest hospital is quite far from here.
sentences.zh: 我忘了帶胰島素，我每餐前都需要注射，而最近的醫院離這裡很遠。

sentences.en: After eating the shellfish at the restaurant, my throat started swelling, which might indicate a severe allergic reaction.
sentences.zh: 在餐廳吃了貝類之後，我的喉嚨開始腫起來，這可能表示嚴重的過敏反應。

sentences.en: The wound on his forehead, caused by a piece of falling debris, will not stop bleeding despite the pressure we applied.
sentences.zh: 他額頭上被掉落碎片造成的傷口，儘管我們已經加壓，仍然止不住血。

sentences.en: I would like to know whether this hospital has an English-speaking doctor available, as I cannot explain my symptoms in the local language.
sentences.zh: 我想知道這家醫院是否有會說英語的醫生，因為我無法用當地語言描述我的症狀。

sentences.en: My travel companion, who is diabetic and has not eaten anything since yesterday, is becoming increasingly disoriented and weak.
sentences.zh: 我的旅伴有糖尿病，從昨天開始就沒有吃東西，越來越意識模糊和虛弱。

sentences.en: The snake that bit her on the ankle was approximately one meter long with distinctive black and yellow markings on its body.
sentences.zh: 咬她腳踝的蛇大約一公尺長，身上有明顯的黑黃色斑紋。

sentences.en: Please tell the paramedics that he takes blood thinners daily, which could explain why the bleeding has been so difficult to control.
sentences.zh: 請告訴急救人員他每天服用抗凝血劑，這可能解釋了為什麼出血這麼難控制。

sentences.en: I have been vomiting repeatedly for the past six hours, and I am now too weak to stand up or walk to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 過去六個小時我一直反覆嘔吐，現在虛弱到無法站起來或走到浴室。

sentences.en: The burn on her hand, which she got from touching the hot stove, is blistering badly and needs professional medical attention.
sentences.zh: 她碰到熱爐子而燙傷的手正在嚴重起水泡，需要專業醫療處理。

sentences.en: Could someone help me carry this injured person, who cannot walk on his own, to the car so we can drive to the hospital?
sentences.zh: 有人能幫我把這位無法自己行走的傷者抬到車上嗎？這樣我們可以開車去醫院。

sentences.en: I think I may have fractured my wrist when I slipped on the wet stairs, because it is swollen and extremely painful to move.
sentences.zh: 我在濕滑的樓梯上滑倒時可能摔斷了手腕，因為它腫了而且動起來非常痛。

sentences.en: The medication I need, which is called epinephrine, should be in my bag that I left at the hotel reception desk.
sentences.zh: 我需要的藥物叫腎上腺素，應該在我放在旅館櫃台的包包裡。

sentences.en: My elderly father, who underwent bypass surgery last month, is now complaining of severe pressure in his chest and shortness of breath.
sentences.zh: 我的老父親上個月剛做了繞道手術，現在抱怨胸口有嚴重的壓迫感和呼吸急促。

sentences.en: While hiking on the mountain trail yesterday afternoon, I twisted my ankle badly and it has become too swollen to fit inside my shoe.
sentences.zh: 昨天下午在山路健行時，我嚴重扭傷了腳踝，腫到鞋子穿不進去。

sentences.en: The person who fainted in the subway station is now regaining consciousness, but she still looks very pale and is shaking uncontrollably.
sentences.zh: 在地鐵站暈倒的那個人現在正在恢復意識，但她看起來仍然很蒼白，而且不停地發抖。

sentences.en: I urgently need a refill of my prescription medication, which I take daily to prevent seizures, because I lost my supply during the trip.
sentences.zh: 我急需補充我的處方藥，我每天服用以預防癲癇發作，因為旅途中弄丟了。

sentences.en: Having witnessed the man suddenly grab his chest and fall to the ground, I immediately began performing CPR while waiting for help to arrive.
sentences.zh: 看到那個男人突然抓住胸口倒地後，我立刻開始做心肺復甦術，同時等待救援到來。

sentences.en: The doctor at the clinic told me that my condition, which involves a high fever and persistent cough, requires immediate hospitalization.
sentences.zh: 診所的醫生告訴我，我的狀況——持續高燒和咳嗽不止——需要立即住院。

sentences.en: Please inform the hospital staff that I am currently taking three different medications, the names of which are written on the card in my wallet.
sentences.zh: 請告知醫院工作人員我目前在服用三種不同的藥物，藥名寫在我皮夾裡的卡片上。
